terbaru.judul: LLMs as Post-hoc Auditors of Physiological Plausibility in Symbolic Regression: A Clinician-Evaluated Case Study
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, we explore whether Large Language Models, can assist in improving the explainability of Symbolic Regression models generated by evolutionary computation methods.

terbaru.judul: Structural Fusion of Bayesian Networks with Limited Treewidth Using Genetic Algorithms
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper introduces an evolutionary computation approach for consensus in structural Bayesian Network (BN) fusion under the constraint of limited treewidth.

terbaru.judul: An Evolutionary Computation Framework for Multi-Agent Q-Learning with Mean-Field Environmental Feedback
terbaru.pelajaran: Multi-agent reinforcement learning in networked populations is governed by the interaction between individual adaptation, local encounters, and changing environmental conditions.

terbaru.judul: Machine learning-assisted calibration of Agent-based Models: surrogate-based optimization with Genetic Algorithm and Particle Swarm Optimization
terbaru.pelajaran: This study adapts inner-loop surrogate-assisted evolutionary computation (SAEC) to ABM calibration by embedding a machine-learning surrogate within genetic algorithm (GA) and particle swarm optimisation (PSO).

terbaru.judul: Genetic Algorithms for Tractable Bayesian Network Fusion via Pre-Fusion Edge Pruning
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose genetic algorithms with advanced initialization, specialized operators, and a tailored fitness function.
